annotations.title: Turn off a result's public link

description: Turns off the public link to one of your results and keeps the result: the run is not deleted, get_simulation_results still returns it, and it can be shared again. Use this when the user wants a link they shared to stop working but wants to keep the result. When the user wants the result itself removed, use delete_run instead: it deletes the result and its link. Pass the run_id of the shared result, not the link or a graph_id. From then on anyone who opens the old link gets "not found", and that link never works again; that is why this tool is marked destructive, though it deletes nothing. It returns revoked true, or false when the run had no active link, so calling it again is harmless. To share the result again, call create_result_share_link: it makes a new link. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.

run_id.description: The run whose public link to turn off, as passed to create_result_share_link. The result is kept.
